blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Coach Delta Pineda is relishing the breakthrough achievement Converge pulled off on Friday when it finished off Rain or Shine to secure the franchise’s first-ever PBA semifinal appearance. The FiberXers got the job done with a 120-109 victory in Game 4 of their 2026 Governors’ Cup quarterfinal series at Smart Araneta Coliseum as they ended a string of quarterfinal failures for the biggest feat in the franchise’s four-year run in the big league. “It’s history for us. God is good,” said Pineda, who has had an on-and-off role with the team since its entry in 2022 until being handed his […]...
